instruction: Set a plain text email signature in Thunderbird with "Prof. Lisa Wang", "Computer Science Department", and "contact@university.edu" on three lines.

metadata.explanation: Academic signature format. Note: dots in email need escaping for regex. Same complexity level as original task.
metadata.verification: Reuses existing check_thunderbird_prefs metric. Signature text verified to match regex escape requirements for special characters (dots, plus signs).

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly extracts signature state by reading Thunderbird prefs.js file after closing the application
Postconfig appropriately closes Thunderbird window and sleeps to ensure preferences are flushed to disk
check_thunderbird_prefs metric correctly parses prefs.js and matches preference values against expected regex patterns
Expected regex pattern correctly matches all three required signature lines with proper escaping of dots
Complete coverage: all instruction requirements (Prof. Lisa Wang, Computer Science Department, contact@university.edu on three lines) are verified
Uses correct Thunderbird preference key mail.identity.id1.htmlSigText which stores signature text content
Regex method re.S enables multi-line matching which is appropriate for newline-separated content
